ValidationRule.description: Competitors Bidding and Bid Award Date are required to close as Won or Lost. Other closure reasons, records created before 2026-08-31, and Bypass CapStrat Validation holders are exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.Bypass_CapStrat_Validation) && OR(ISNEW(), CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE("2026-08-31 00:00:00")) && ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "RFP Closed") && OR( ISPICKVAL(RFP_Closed__c, "Won"), ISPICKVAL(RFP_Closed__c, "Lost") ) && ( ISBLANK(Competitor_Name__c) || ISBLANK(Bid_Award_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close this Capture Strategy as Won or Lost, first fill in Competitors Bidding and Bid Award Date.
